jobs.title: Living Room Ceiling & Crown Restoration
jobs.summary: A full ceiling rebuild and custom cherry crown molding, reproduced to match the original, in a 1920s living room.
jobs.body:
The ceiling in this living room had to come down to the joists. We rebuilt it with Type-X drywall, coordinated the new recessed lighting, and reproduced the room's substantial cherry crown molding to match the existing profile so the finished room reads as original.

All carpentry by our crew. We hired and managed the painter, electrician, and floor finisher, so the homeowner had one point of contact start to finish.
scope: Custom cherry crown molding, matched to the original

photos.caption: Before: the ceiling opened to the joists.
Finished, before the furniture came back.
The finished room, three years on.
Cherry crown and paneling, matched to the original.

jobs.title: Third-Floor Renovation & Custom Radiator Covers
jobs.summary: Green carpet and bare radiators out; hardwood floors, recessed lighting, new trim, and shop-built radiator covers in.
jobs.body:
The second project in this house: a top-to-bottom refresh of the third floor. We reworked a doorway, ran new trim, and built custom radiator covers for the bedrooms in our shop, finished in a warm stain with brass grilles (one with a cutout for the thermostat).

All carpentry by our crew. We hired and managed the electrician, plumber, painter, and floor finisher.
scope: Shop-built radiator covers with brass grilles
Hardwood floor and recessed lighting coordination

photos.caption: Radiator cover frames in the shop.
Custom radiator cover with brass grille.
Thermostat cutout built into the top.
After: hardwood, recessed lights, new trim.

jobs.title: Staircase & Balcony Railing Rebuild
jobs.summary: A worn staircase re-skinned in new hardwood ahead of a carpet runner, with a custom rail whose profile matches the home's original millwork.
jobs.body:
The third project in this house. The stair was getting a carpet runner, so instead of replacing treads nobody would see, we stiffened and re-secured the existing structure, then skinned the exposed edges in new hardwood: returned tread caps, nosings, and riser faces sized to frame the runner.

The new rail was built by hand: curved sections joined and shaped in place, box newels, iron balusters, and a profile cut from a template of the original rail so it belongs to the house.

All carpentry by our crew. We hired and managed the painter, electrician, and floor finisher.
scope: Structural re-securing of the existing stair
New hardwood tread caps, nosings, and riser faces
Custom handrail with hand-fitted curved sections
Profile matched to the original millwork

photos.caption: A template cut from the original rail, so the new profile matches.
Curved rail section, joined and shaped by hand.
New nosings and newels before finish.
Balcony railing, raw, with the iron balusters in.

jobs.title: Open Porch to Home Office
jobs.summary: An open-air porch framed, closed in, and finished as a year-round home office, with built-ins, French doors, and a herringbone floor.
jobs.body:
We took this open porch down to the structure and built it back as a finished room: new framing and sheathing, Marvin windows, siding and exterior trim, insulation, drywall, French doors, a herringbone floor, and a wall of built-in cabinets with floating shelves.

We ran the whole job as general contractor, hiring and managing the electrician and HVAC contractor; everything else was done by our own crew.

photos.caption: Before: the open porch, gutted to the structure.
French doors and the herringbone floor.
The finished office: built-ins, floating shelves, and a feature wall.

jobs.title: Covered Patio with Privacy Screens
jobs.summary: A new covered patio built from the piers up: steel posts, framed roof, metal roofing, built-up cornice, wrapped columns, and custom-designed privacy screens.
jobs.body:
Starting from an existing deck, we poured concrete piers, set steel posts and a timber beam, framed and sheathed the roof, and finished it with a metal roof, a built-up painted cornice, wrapped columns, and a beadboard ceiling with recessed lights, all in the house's colors.

The privacy screens and matching AC-unit cover were designed for this patio: we laid out the pattern, built the frames and posts, and set the cut panels so the whole structure reads as one piece. Everything except the electrical was done by our crew.
scope: Custom-designed privacy screens and AC cover

photos.caption: Piers going in through the existing deck.
Screen frames being built on site.
Privacy screens wrapped around the column.

jobs.title: Kitchen Remodel
jobs.summary: A full kitchen remodel with white shaker cabinetry, a two-tone island, and a custom ceiling box over the island that carries the pendants.
jobs.body: Taken down to the studs and rebuilt: new cabinetry, a large two-tone island, paneled appliance walls, and a custom-built ceiling box over the island that frames the pendant lights and hides the mechanicals above.
scope: Cabinet installation and paneled appliance walls
Custom ceiling box over the island

photos.caption: Custom ceiling box over the island.

jobs.title: Kitchen & Laundry Room Remodel
jobs.summary: A new kitchen with a large island and a laundry room rebuilt with a farmhouse sink and butcher-block counters.
jobs.body: Two rooms, one job: a full kitchen remodel with new cabinetry, a long island with seating and built-in microwave drawer, and a laundry room rebuilt with cabinetry, a farmhouse sink, and butcher-block counters.

photos.caption: Laundry room with farmhouse sink and butcher block.

jobs.title: Kitchen & Living Room Remodel
jobs.summary: White shaker cabinets, quartz counters, and a sliding barn-door pantry, with the adjoining living room refreshed to match.
jobs.body: A kitchen and living room remodel in Ohio City: new cabinetry, quartz countertops, a wide island, and a pantry closet with a sliding barn door, plus the living room and fireplace surround refreshed to match.
scope: Living room trim and fireplace surround

jobs.title: Secret Bookcase Door
jobs.summary: A full-height bookcase that is also a door, with a hidden latch and a custom hinge setup, built to disappear into the room.
jobs.body: One of the custom pieces we get asked about most. This bookcase is a working door: a full-height case on a concealed pivot, a hidden latch, and casing detailed to match the rest of the room so nothing gives it away.

jobs.title: Third-Floor Finish & Wet Bar
jobs.summary: A third floor finished with paneled knee walls, built-in cabinets under the eaves, a wet bar, and new doors.
jobs.body: A full third-floor finish in Ohio City: paneled knee walls with built-in storage under the eaves, a wet bar with a tiled backsplash, new doors, and trim throughout, all fitted to the angles of the roofline.
scope: Paneled knee walls with built-in storage

photos.caption: Paneled knee walls and window seat.

jobs.title: Front Porch Restoration & Rear Deck
jobs.summary: A Victorian front porch restored with new decking, turned balusters, and steps, plus a new composite rear deck with aluminum railing.
jobs.body: Two outdoor projects on one Ohio City house: the front porch restored with new decking, turned balusters, skirting, and steps in the original style, and a new composite rear deck with black aluminum railing.
scope: Front porch decking, balusters, skirting, and steps

jobs.title: Front Porch Restoration
jobs.summary: A historic front porch brought back to its original design: columns, railings, and lattice rebuilt to match.
jobs.body: Restoring the original design and charm of a historic porch: columns and capitals repaired, railings and panels rebuilt to the original pattern, new steps and skirting, with attention to the details that make it read as period-correct.
scope: Railings rebuilt to the original pattern

jobs.title: Stairs & Railing in a Timber-Frame Home
jobs.summary: A staircase and loft railing designed and built to suit a timber-frame house.
jobs.body: We designed and built this staircase and loft railing to match the heavy timber construction of the house: solid posts, square balusters, and a landing that turns the corner, all in the same wood as the frame.

jobs.title: Sanctuary, Stage & Vestibule Renovation
jobs.summary: A church sanctuary renovated while it stayed in use: a new raised stage, backlit wall panels, and a rebuilt vestibule.
jobs.body: For West Shore Unitarian Universalist Church we rebuilt the stage platform with a curved front, framed and paneled the sanctuary's front wall with backlit panels, and renovated the vestibule, while the congregation kept meeting. The entries were boarded and protected so the building stayed safe and open throughout.
scope: Site protection for an occupied building

photos.caption: Entries protected while the building stayed open.

jobs.title: Water-Damage Repair & Room Renovation
jobs.summary: What looked like a ceiling repair turned out to be rotted structural framing. The painter who first looked at it sent the church to us.
jobs.body:
Lakewood Presbyterian called a painter about a water-damaged ceiling. When he opened it up he found rotted framing, told them it was beyond what he could repair, and referred us.

We opened the wall and ceiling to the brick and rafters, cut out the rot, rebuilt the framing, and closed it in with new drywall ready for finish. To keep the rest of the building usable, we built a temporary wall across the room, metal-stud framed and skinned in Masonite, with a real hung door, and kept the cutting station outside it. The church never had to close.
scope: Temporary framed enclosure with door for dust control

photos.caption: What was behind it: rotted framing at the brick.
The work area sealed off from the rest of the room.
A framed temporary wall with a hung door kept the dust in and the building open.
Inside the enclosure: metal-stud framed, skinned in Masonite.

jobs.title: Rear Patio & Wall Caps
jobs.summary: Heaved flagstone reset and crumbling brick wall caps replaced with new stone at the church's rear entrance.
jobs.body: The second project for Lakewood Presbyterian: the rear patio's flagstone had heaved and broken, and the brick planter walls had lost their caps. We reset the stone and set new stone caps on the walls so the entrance is level, safe, and finished.

photos.caption: Before: broken caps and heaved stone.
New stone caps on the planter walls.

jobs.title: Catering Kitchen Build-Out
jobs.summary: In progress: the carpentry on a new catering kitchen, from steel entry doors and structural steel to metal-stud framing.
jobs.body:
We're the carpentry contractor on this build-out for Stone Mad, working under the project's general contractor. So far: old wood doors replaced with commercial steel doors, the space gutted to brick and joists, a new steel post and beam set, and the kitchen layout framed in metal stud with soffits and chases. We brought in our own roofer and siding crew; the GC's electrician, HVAC, and plumbing trades are handling theirs.

More photos when it's finished.

photos.caption: Kitchen layout framed in metal stud.

jobs.title: Dining Room & Bar Expansion
jobs.summary: A restaurant expanded into the next space: new bar, dining room, and finishes.
jobs.body: We expanded Taco Tantos in Lakewood into the adjoining space: a new bar with a wood top, banquette seating, a private dining nook, and all the carpentry behind the color.

jobs.title: Dining Counter, POS Station & Side Station
jobs.summary: Custom design-build counters for a quick-service restaurant: a long window dining counter, a POS station, and a side station.
jobs.body: A design-build package for The Souper Market: a long wood dining counter along the windows, a POS and pickup counter with glass panels, and a matching side station, all built to take restaurant traffic.
